delta.context: CPL MTD RM25.37 vs last month full RM23.80 (beza RM+1.57, +6.60%) - memburuk sikit bulan ni. Projected full-month spend ~RM39,811.53 (vs RM30,156.56 bulan lepas) naik 32.0% - run-rate spend tetap naik drastik seiring byk campaign/adset baru (PCS26, Kelas Petang, Shah Alam VID) scale. Projected CPL penuh bulan RM25.37 (projection linear ikut pace MTD semasa - sama dgn CPL MTD). Tapi pace sebenar boleh berubah dlm 13 hari lagi bulan ni bergantung sama ada campaign RED (090326 TESTING2, 120826 SHAH ALAM) di-optimize atau dibiar jalan.
delta.recommendation: CPL masih dlm range KUNING (bawah RM30) tapi trending naik - watch spend run-rate ketat. Kalau budget bulanan terhad, kena plan sekarang sama ada nak slow down testing adset baru (terutama 090326 TESTING2 & 120826 SHAH ALAM yg baru flip RED) atau top-up budget. Jangan biar testing budget melebihi 25-30% total spend.
